How it works
  1. Find the existing profile or request an accurately labeled create-profile path.
  2. Correct public facts for free and preserve the real physical city or service area.
  3. Use Franklin Assistant or the free Growth Planner to choose a useful local goal.
  4. Preview richer member value and decide whether Community Membership fits.
